title: Senior Payroll Specialist (Portugal)
descriptionHtml:
✨ One platform, a whole world of opportunity

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

  • Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies

  • Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 by Newsweek

  • A G2 Spring 2026 Leader across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

  • The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023

Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

Location: To create the best experience for this employee and meet business needs, this role requires you to be based in Portugal and have the right to work in this location.

Role Summary

This is an exciting time to join Oyster. Portugal is one of our most important markets and this role will give you real ownership over how payroll runs, with the scope to help us achieve best-in-class payroll standards at scale.

You'll be our lead in-house payroll expert: the person we trust to own Portuguese payroll end-to-end, build scalable workflows in Cegid (Primavera or PHC) and / or Sendys, and set the standard for how payroll should run. If you've run native Portuguese payroll from the ground up, know Primavera inside out, have strong opinions on doing payroll right, and have helped build or transform a payroll function before, this role is built for you.

Core Responsibilities

  • Run payroll end-to-end. Own the full Portuguese payroll cycle in-house; accurate, compliant, and on time.

  • Master data ownership. Oversee the validation of employee payroll master data, including new hires, terminations, salary changes, variable pay, payroll-related benefits (including meal vouchers and other employee benefits), absences, and garnishments (penhoras de vencimento), ensuring every change is processed accurately and within payroll deadlines.

  • Payroll controls & quality. Run rigorous pre- and post-payroll validations each cycle, investigate discrepancies, and implement corrective actions to keep payroll accurate before issues reach team members, customers or Finance.

  • Handle all statutory filings & accesses. Monthly IRS withholding declarations, DMR (Declaração Mensal de Remunerações) filings to Segurança Social, and the annual Modelo 10 filing, filing of subsídio de doença and subsídio parental reimbursement claims, owning the retrieval and maintenance of employee IRS withholding codes: you own and oversee these activities. You will also be responsible for setting up and managing required government accesses.

  • Own the payroll system. Configure and maintain the in-house payroll system, test legislative updates before they go live, troubleshoot issues, and partner with our Product team to improve automation and scalability.

  • Be the subject matter expert. Advise the business on Direito Fiscal (IRS), Direito da Segurança Social, Direito do Trabalho, and Contrato Coletivo de Trabalho (CCT) interpretation.

  • Own the numbers. Oversee payroll journals, GL mappings, reconciliations with Finance, and full data integrity.

  • Own complex escalations. Be the key point of contact for our most complex client payroll issues. Pair your deep technical expertise with a customer-first mindset to turn hard problems into a best-in-class experience.

  • Reporting. Maintain and prepare statutory and ad-hoc reports to meet regulatory requirements, including EU Pay Transparency Directive obligations, Comissão de Trabalhadores-facing pay assessment documentation, and RGPD/GDPR compliance across payroll data.

  • Audits. Provide structured data and documentation to support internal and external audits.

  • Level the team up. Improve processes, coach junior specialists through complex problems rather than solving issues for them, and back up Regional Managers when needed. Maintain a living knowledge base e.g. playbooks and SOPs. so legal updates and process knowledge stay documented and shared, never siloed.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years running the complete native (in-house) payroll process for Portugal, comfortable independently handling a high volume of payslips per month.

  • Advanced, hands-on experience with Portuguese payroll software Cegid (Primavera or PHC) and / or Sendys is essential.

  • Completed a recognized accounting/payroll qualification (e.g. Contabilista Certificado) and/or a dedicated payroll processing certification.

  • Deep, current working knowledge of Portuguese wage tax, social insurance, and labor law, and the confidence to advise stakeholders directly, not just execute.

  • Portuguese at C1/C2 for interaction with local authorities and fluent English for collaborating with our async global team.

  • Comfortable owning complex, sensitive client escalations; balancing technical precision with a genuine customer-first mindset.

  • An analytical, productivity-obsessed mindset. You're not a corporate "just follow the process" type; you thrive working from a blank canvas to build and set up processes, with an automation mindset that keeps improving how the work gets done.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving cross-functional change, even without an established playbook.

  • Some experience coaching or mentoring less experienced colleagues; you like building others up, not just solving problems yourself.

  • Comfortable working largely asynchronously in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Desirable Skills

  • A broader accounting background or qualification (e.g. Revisor Oficial de Contas); particularly useful for the GL mapping and reconciliation side of the role.

  • Proven experience working on and delivering cross-functional HR/Payroll projects.

  • Hands-on capability working with AI tools to optimize payroll or operations workflows.

  • Strong data transformation skills and practical experience with data analytics platforms.

How we work together at Oyster

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the Oyster Public HQ so other global teams can learn from us.

How YOU work

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created How YOU Work; a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

  • Work from anywhere: Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

  • Paid time off: Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

  • Mental health support: Access Plumm, our mental well-being service.

  • Wellbeing allowance: Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

  • Flexible parental leave: All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

  • WFH stipend: Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.

✨ The best jobs should be available to everyone 

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email jobs@oysterhr.com with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @oysterhr.com email, and we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer. If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than www.oysterhr.com/careers, please report it via our Compliance and Ethics Helpline.
